spans.s:
m. (-म्पः)
Smearing, anointing, plastering.
E.
लिप to smear, (taking in its derivative forms the nasal augment,) and श aff.

m. (-टः)
A lecher, a whore-monger.
E.
लिपि to smear with unguents, अटच् aff.; also लम्पट.

m. (-कः)
1 The lime tree, (Citrus acida.)
2 An ass.
E.
लिपि to smear, aff. काकन्.
